title: 1 John 2:16 — lust of the flesh, lust of the eyes, pride of life
summary: 1 John 2:16 in English: all that is in the world — the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes and the pride of life — is not of the Father but of the world. Each of the three is set on its own line.

text.text: 16 For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

numbers.note: three kinds of temptation: lust of the flesh, lust of the eyes, pride of life
